store.address: 3, Rashtrapati Bhavan Rd, Central Secretariat, Kartavya Path, New Delhi, Delhi 110011, India

files.products.jsonl: One nested JSON object per product.
files.products.csv: Flat typed view with derived columns.

schema.product_id: Blinkit's own SKU id. Unique per store, stable across runs.
schema.pack: Parsed from the free-text `unit` field. kind is weight|volume|count|mixed, or null when the text did not parse (raw is always kept). Measured on this catalog, effectively every null is a book SKU: Blinkit puts the author or publisher in the unit field for books ('Ruskin Bond', 'Maple Press'), so a null kind on a Books shelf is a byline, not a missing pack size.
schema.pack.net_g: Total net grams in the pack, multipacks and combos summed.
schema.pack.net_ml: Total net millilitres in the pack.
schema.pack.pieces: Total countable pieces (pc, set, pair, sheet, ...).
schema.pricing.mrp: Printed maximum retail price, INR. Null when not advertised.
schema.pricing.unit_price: price normalized per kg / per litre / per piece.
schema.availability.in_stock: As the store served it at scrape time.
schema.images: Image assets from Blinkit's CDN. asset_id is the CDN filename, usable as a dedup key. local_path is set only after download_images.py has run.
schema.taxonomy: Every shelf the product sits on. A product can sit on several.
schema.provenance: Which endpoint the row came from, which store, and when. Inventory is per-darkstore: another pin is a different catalog.
